Noto Sans Arabic Regular and Bold are embedded in Infrastructure.dll and registered once by OrderPdfFonts.
This keeps Arabic PDF rendering independent of the working directory, loose font files, and installed system fonts.
QuestPDF's bundled Lato remains the Latin font; Noto Sans Arabic supplies Arabic glyphs.

Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSansArabic
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, included in OFL.txt and copied to build/publish output.
